notes: No mock inference is described as model validation.
Chinese CER and English WER are primary; Chinese WER is not linguistically segmented.
No reference/normalization changes were made to improve scores. High Chinese CER remains a quality risk.
Synthetic results do not substitute for representative licensed human-speech quality testing; separate human diagnostics are not mixed into these scores.
Observed latency is under variable shared CPU load, including separate Qwen activity; no isolated speedup claim.
Archive byte sizes identify downloaded payload artifacts; network traffic remains unmeasured.
Null GPU memory means unmeasured, never zero usage.
First request includes model initialization/inference with already-acquired weights; service startup/download excluded.
